tips: Focus on high‑performing themes like "trusting Allah (tawakkul)", "reflection on a Quran verse" and "honesty and trust (amanah)"; use reels more than longs as reels have higher average score
Create hook titles that promise a miracle or a powerful lesson, e.g., "Qurani Ayat ka Asar" or "Prophet ki Ajeeb Haqeeqat" and keep them under 8 words
Limit content length to 30‑45 seconds for reels and 2‑3 minutes for long videos to maintain engagement
Avoid low‑scoring topics such as "controlling anger" and "value of salah" and replace them with proven themes
Add English subtitles for the Gulf and Western audience to boost shares and views
